subject: Marketplace onboarding: entitlement & procurement intake (AWS first)
messages:

Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:23:00 -0800
Subject: Getting started: Redwood marketplace listing (AWS/Azure/GCP)

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at CloudRetail AI is excited to get listed on Redwood's marketplace. We want to prioritize AWS first, then roll out to Azure and GCP. Can you outline the procurement / entitlement steps we need to complete on our side and what forms Redwood needs? Specifically:

- What tax / entity paperwork do you require?
- How does PO routing work once we go live on AWS Marketplace?
- Any specific marketplace billing mapping we should prepare?

I'm including procurement@cloudretail.ai on this thread so they have visibility. I can attach our W-9 and bank remittance stub if that helps.

Thanks,

--
Sofia Park
Head of Partnerships
CloudRetail AI
sofia.park@cloudretail.ai
procurement@cloudretail.ai

(Attachment: CloudRetail_W-9.pdf)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Park <sofia.park@cloudretail.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Getting started: Redwood marketplace listing (AWS/Azure/GCP)

Hi Sofia — great to hear and glad the demo was useful. Looping in Vanessa (go-to-market / billing) and Lauren (legal/marketplace paperwork) so we can coordinate procurement and entitlement. High level next steps below; I attached our Marketplace_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx and the Redwood_PO_Template.docx for your finance team.

1) Entity & tax paperwork (needed to configure billing and invoices)
   - Legal name, EIN (or VAT if non-US), W-9 or W-8 as applicable
   - Primary invoice email and billing contact

2) Marketplace listing intake (AWS first)
   - Marketplace forms differ slightly by cloud. We will provide the listing metadata sheet; you should confirm the product SKU and pricing cadence.

3) PO & invoicing flow
   - Redwood can accept marketplace-driven purchases (AWS invoicing) or direct PO invoicing depending on your preference and entitlement mapping. For AWS Marketplace, purchases will often be billed through AWS and we reconcile via marketplace invoices. If you need Redwood to issue a PO outside marketplace billing, use the attached PO template and we will route it to our accounting team.

4) Security/compliance evidence
   - Please indicate if you need any SOC2/ISO summaries. We can share a redacted SOC2 packet once NDA/LOU is signed.

5) Timeline suggestion
   - If you return the checklist + tax forms within 5 business days, we can target a first/initial listing in ~3 weeks (paperwork + listing QA).

Next steps for you: confirm preferred billing mode (AWS-billed vs Redwood PO), attach W-9/EIN, and fill the onboarding checklist. Vanessa — can you confirm any billing gating or minimums from finance? Lauren — anything else legal needs to see for marketplace agreements?

Best,
Marcus
Director, Partner Channels
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: Marketplace_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx; Redwood_PO_Template.docx)

From: Sofia Park <sofia.park@cloudretail.ai>

Thanks Marcus — useful checklist. Quick clarifications: 

- We'll start AWS-only and confirm Azure/GCP later.
- Attached: CloudRetail_W-9.pdf and bank_remit_stub.pdf. Our legal entity is CloudRetail AI, Inc.; EIN 12-3456789.
- We do have a SOC2 Type II report and can provide a short summary — would you prefer full evidence or a summary for the initial listing?

On billing mode: we'd prefer to route purchases through AWS Marketplace for our customers (simpler for procurement), but we may also request Redwood-issued POs for some enterprise deals. Can Redwood support both flows?

I'll fill the onboarding checklist today and return it.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

--
Sofia
(Attachments: CloudRetail_W-9.pdf; bank_remit_stub.pdf)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Park <sofia.park@cloudretail.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Getting started: Redwood marketplace listing (AWS/Azure/GCP)

Hi Sofia — thanks for the files and confirmation. A few procurement points from Finance: 

- AWS Marketplace flow: yes, we support purchases routed through AWS. In that case, AWS issues the invoice to the buyer and we reconcile via AWS settlement files. For your internal accounting to map costs, we recommend setting a unique SKU and including the buyer's account alias in the order notes.
- Redwood-issued PO flow: we can accept POs; please use the attached Redwood_PO_Template.docx and send to accounting@redwoodinference.com. Our standard net30 terms apply unless otherwise negotiated.
- Billing gating: no minimums for marketplace listing, but for direct PO invoicing we require finance review for enterprise committals > $50k ARR.

On evidence: for initial listing a SOC2 summary is fine — full report can be shared later under NDA. Please upload the summary to the Drive link Marcus shared or use the DocuSign link for tax forms if you prefer signed exchange.

I'll add a short checklist for purchase routing on the drive. Lauren — flagging if legal needs to push any marketplace-specific clauses before listing.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
(Attachment referenced: billing_mapping_readme.pdf — will upload to shared drive)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>

Great — thanks everyone. Recap and agreed next steps: 

- CloudRetail (Sofia / procurement@cloudretail.ai): fill and return Marketplace_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx; upload SOC2 summary to the shared drive; confirm final SKU and pricing cadence.
- CloudRetail: if you want Redwood-issued POs for select deals, route PO to accounting@redwoodinference.com using Redwood_PO_Template.docx. Otherwise, we will treat AWS-billed purchases as primary flow for marketplace purchases.
- Redwood (Vanessa): prepare billing mapping readme and initial reconciliation template (drive link).
- Redwood (Lauren): please confirm there are no additional marketplace legal blockers for AWS listing (I believe none beyond standard marketplace terms).

Target timeline: checklist + tax files returned by 2026-11-25 -> initial AWS listing QA week of 2026-12-06 -> aim to go live (soft launch) by 2026-12-15.

HubSpot record: https://hubspot.example/CRAI-927 (please add procurement contact).

If that timeline works I'll add a calendar invite for an onboarding sync next Tuesday (Nov 23) at 11am PT.

Best regards,
Marcus
